title: rosa afzeliana var. cinerea
intro: Rosa afzeliana var. cinerea, commonly known as the Rosa rugosa or Chinese rose, is a species of rose native to China and Korea. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa afzeliana var. cinerea include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, making it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Rosa afzeliana var. cinerea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
